تختبزوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِزُوا (taḵtabizū) /tax.ta.bi.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
# تُخْتَبَزُوا (tuḵtabazū) /tux.ta.ba.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
